title: PRISM: Reducing Spurious Implicit Biases in Vision-Language Models with LLM-Guided Embedding Projection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset to measure the model's reliance on spuriously correlated background environments (e.g., water vs. land backgrounds) instead of the actual target object.
Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset to measure spurious correlations between target classifications and socially relevant facial attributes, such as gender and hair color.
